name: Prevent Multiple Form Submissions
description: Server-side validation that blocks duplicate/concurrent submissions of the same form (and guards custom operations) using persistent locks keyed per visitor, form and configurable timeout.
project_description: Server-side submit request validation that prevents multiple form submissions. Per-form configuration sets a timeout during which a further submission of the same form (by the same visitor) is rejected with a configurable validation message; an optional 'skip timeout' releases the lock as soon as the initial submit finishes so the visitor need not wait out the full window. The module works by adding its own validate/submit handlers to every button of enabled forms via hook_form_alter, acquiring a persistent lock (core lock.persistent backend) keyed on the form id plus a per-visitor cookie. It also exposes a small service API (isCustomRequestExecutable / setCustomRequestDone) so custom controllers can wrap their own operations in the same locking mechanism to keep a single processing operation per visitor. A development mode records every rendered form id to help administrators find the ids to configure.
